title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs – Remote MCP Server Support
description: Supports connecting to remote MCP servers through the Work IQ endpoint, enabling agents to securely invoke external tools and services beyond the local runtime for richer, distributed agent orchestration.
